To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

complete implementation of Mpower policy package in Israel has the potential to reduce the prevalence of smoking by 34%, avert 245 thousand deaths, and reduce the exposure of the nonsmokers to the second hand smoke.
full implementation of the WHO MPOWER policy package has the potential to reduce the number of smoking-related deaths in Israel by about 20 %.
full implementation of Mpower policy package in Israel would reduce smoking prevalence by about 34 % within 40 years and would prevent about 245,000 premature smoking-attributable deaths.

the following question: What would happen to tobacco use in Israel if the MPOWER policy recommendations were fully implemented?
the impact of the implementation of MPOWER policy on reducing the number of premature deaths due to tobacco consumption in Israel.
the impact of tobacco on health and the effectiveness of policies to reduce tobacco-related mortality and morbidity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Abridged model is a useful tool for policy makers and health professionals.
the Abridged Israeli SimSmoke model indicates that full implementation of the FCTC MPOWER policies will reduce smoking prevalence and save lives in Israel.
the MPOWER package is expected to substantially reduce premature mortality in Israel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Israel has made substantial progress in implementing MPOWER strategies.
Israel Abridged Sim Smoke model shows the potential of MPOWER strategies for Israel to substantially reduce smoking, and avert deaths from smoking.
the MPOWER package has the potential to reduce premature deaths by about 20 % in Israel, and that the Abridged model provides a useful tool for estimating the effects of the MPOWER policies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MPOWER policy recommendations are a cost-effective and feasible way to reduce smoking rates and the burden of disease from smoking.
the Abridged model is an effective tool for estimating smoking-attributable deaths in Israel and for estimating the potential effects of implementing MPOWER policies.
the FCTC MPOWER policy package has the potential to reduce premature deaths from smoking in Israel.
